executionScopes.title: Johnny meeting bot — ongoing work, fixes, and end-to-end validation
executionScopes.description:
## Why this exists

Umbrella epic for the Johnny Google Meet AI Meeting Bot post-MVP work.

The original join-stuck bug (Johnny-ckz.1) is fixed and the bot now reliably joins meetings (commit 979447e). The remaining scope spans:
- End-to-end validation against real Google Meet (across all modes)
- Adding/refining bot behavior modes (Autonomous, free-mode speech logic)
- Provider integration polish (TTS demo playback, ElevenLabs verification, openai-realtime fix)
- UX improvements (UI-driven Google sign-in, full-meeting context vs rolling window)
- Smoke tests and provider management UI tests

All child issues here are tracked under this single epic.

## Acceptance

- All child issues closed
- Bot has been validated end-to-end across every mode against a real Google Meet
- Provider management surface is polished and tested via UI
